title: gRPC Services
concept: gRPC services in XIOM — strongly-typed RPC with Protocol Buffers for high-performance microservice communication.
why: REST is text-heavy and loosely typed. gRPC is binary and strongly typed — faster, smaller, and with built-in code generation for client and server stubs.
tips: gRPC uses HTTP/2 — multiplexed streams, header compression, binary framing
Protobuf is strongly typed — field numbers matter, don't change them after release
Streaming is gRPC's killer feature — use it for large datasets, live updates, and bidirectional communication
Deadlines: always set a timeout on gRPC calls to avoid hanging requests
common_mistakes: Changing protobuf field numbers — breaks backward compatibility
Using gRPC for browser clients without gRPC-web proxy — browsers can't do raw HTTP/2
Forgetting that gRPC is binary — debugging requires tools like grpcurl, not curl
